title: NYC Sportfishing Charters

services.name: Nyc Fishing
services.desc: Catch some of NYC’s biggest fish while out on the water in one of our charters. NYC fishing is a favorite past time for many locals, catching a variety of fishes at different times of the year. Join us on a fishing trip to find your next trophy fish out in the beautiful open sea. When you board our charter you are receiving exceptional fishing tips from experts who have been in the industry for years. Our fully equipped boat has everything you need while out at sea. Come out and explore a new hobby while catching heavy fish and meeting unique and adventure seeking people just like you. Land your biggest catch yet. From striped bass to fluke and blackfish, our guides will show you the ropes

blurb: At NYC Sportfishing Charters, we specialize in catching trophy Striped Bass in and around New York City (NYC) throughout most of the season. In late spring and summer we also fish for trophy doormat Fluke, Black Sea bass and other bottom fish. In the late fall we fish for Blackfish (Tautog).
